name: figma-file
description: Lê arquivos do Figma exportados como .fig (web ou desktop): páginas, camadas, textos, estilos e componentes, sem API nem rate limit.

metadata.short_description: Importe um .fig do Figma e deixe o agente ler o arquivo inteiro
metadata.mesh_description: Reads Figma files from a .fig export instead of the Figma API, so it works with any seat (including View-only) and has no rate limit. **Import** - figma_import opens a guided UI that shows how to export the file (File > Save local copy, on figma.com or the desktop app) and uploads only the document (a few MB; images stay on the user's machine). **Read** - figma_list_files, figma_get_pages, figma_get_node (all properties: fills, strokes, effects, auto-layout, text, component props), figma_search (by name, text, node type, subtree), figma_get_texts and figma_get_styles (shared styles and variables). Node ids accept the node-id from Figma URLs. **Storage** - imported documents are kept in the connected object storage. **Limits** - snapshot of the moment of export (re-import to refresh); no comments or image downloads yet.
